newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Tupras buys 75,000 t gas oil,50,000 t gasoline.
newsitem.headline: Turk Tupras buys 75,000 t gas oil,50,000 t gasoline.

text.p: Turkey's state oil refinery Tupras has imported a total of 75,000 tonnes of gas oil and 50,000 tonnes of gasoline through two tenders, it said in a statement.
It said Tupras imported about 25,000 tonnes of gasoline from Poten for July 29-31 shipment from Theodori port for a discount of $12 per tonne FOB.
It bought about 25,000 tonnes from Masefield for a discount of $17.47 per tonne FOB. The batch will be shipped on August 5-7 from Constanza.

Tempo sold Tupras 50,000 tonnes of gas oil in two equal cargoes. The one to be delivered to Mersin port on August 5-10 has a $9.43 per tonne premium CFR, and the other cargo to be delivered to Tutunciftligi on August 11-14 has a premium of $8.24 per tonne CFR.
Tupras also bought 25,000 tonnes of gasoil from Glencore to be delivered to Tutunciftligi on July 28-31 for a premium of $7.99 per tonne CFR.
All discounts and premiums are based on Italy Mediterranean published quotes.
The tenders were issued on July 15 and 16, Tupras said.
